name: Nagyszokoly (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner with two horizontal bands of blue and yellow at the bottom, charged near the top with the municipal arms of Nagyszokoly (a red and blue shield with a patriarchal cross, a white bird and a sabre) above a yellow scroll inscribed NAGYSZOKOLY.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
